messages:
max_sales: FYI - Lifecare wants a tight-scoped POC: CA + EU only, BYOK (customer-managed), and an explicit no-US-subprocessor requirement for PHI. Also asking if we can show per-region latency and egress splits in the dashboard.

tess_se: Quick questions from AE: 1) Is control-plane isolation required or just data-plane? 2) Can they accept our telemetry off mode instead of full Private? 3) Do they need hard tenant pinning or region-preference?

ian_ops: Operational summary:
- Hosted + Dedicated with hard tenant pin works for data-plane residency; control plane still in US by default unless Private.
- We can disable telemetry and block US subprocessors at the tenant level for the POC, but legal must approve subproc attestation.
- BYOK supported (AWS/GCP KMS ARNs). Require HSM-backed keys and an allow-use key policy.

zoe_sec: Security checklist for a HIPAA-scoped POC:
- Signed BAA before onboarding.
- Subprocessor attestation confirming no US access to PHI for this tenant.
- BYOK attest for HSM + rotation policy.
- Retain access logs for 365d and provide export access.
- Any deferred security controls require explicit written acceptance.

legal-bot: legal-bot: Uploaded signed BAA and initial questionnaire to vault: https://vault.redwood.example/lifecare-2026

max_sales: Pricing and timeline asks:
- Monthly uplift for small Dedicated pool pinned to CA+EU with BYOK?
- One-time onboarding days and who needs to be involved?
- Can we produce per-region egress billing during POC?

ian_ops: Ballpark:
- Dedicated small pool ~ $5,800/mo + ~12% ops surcharge for BYOK/pinning.
- Private (regional control plane) adds ~$16k one-time + ~$7k/mo uplift.
- Onboarding 2-4 business days if legal gets subproc sign-off fast.
- We can tag egress and export CSV for billing; Console shows per-region latency metrics.

tess_se: Action items:
- @ian_ops: post a 1-page POC checklist with required artifacts (KMS ARN, subproc whitelist, contact) by EOD.
- @zoe_sec: mark mandatory vs deferable HIPAA items for a 2-week POC.
- @max_sales: confirm if Lifecare accepts hosted control plane or needs Private.

max_sales: I'll check with AE now. If hosted control-plane is ok, target start next Wed. If Private is required, will need exec and additional lead time. Keeping thread as single source of truth. :thumbsup:
